page.overview:
What is Adama's Tooth?

Adama's Tooth was a lone mountain found in Durpar in the Shining Lands.

The mountain towered over the surrounding terrain, reaching a height of which caused the city of Huorm, located to the east, to experience an early dusk each day.

The mountain sat at the northern end of the Tail, forming a natural end to the peninsula.

Snow and ice covered the higher altitudes of Adama's Tooth, but pine trees grew on the slopes below.
